hec.rss.model

Class DayOfWeekMultiplier

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.rss.model.DayOfWeekMultiplier
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, AltInputReportInfc, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable

    public class DayOfWeekMultiplier
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, AsciiSerializable, AltInputReportInfc
    DayOfWeekMultiplier.java This object consists of an array of doubles that act as a multiplier value for each day of the week, MONDAY-SUNDAY
    Author:
    Shannon Newbold.
